nom: TULA The Cult Classic Luminous Purifying & Brightening Gel Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers describing normal-to-oily, oily lower face, or oily/sensitive skin report the gel cleanses the oily T-zone thoroughly without adding to oiliness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including dryness around the nose and mouth, report the cleanser moisturizes while cleansing and does not leave the tight, stripped feeling they associate with the original formula.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (including one with a dry T-zone and oily lower face, and a 66-year-old with combination skin) report a balanced clean, though one notes the formula feels tighter and more drying on her combination skin than the original.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as smell-sensitive or having sensitive skin generally report the fragrance does not bother them and skin looks smooth and glowing, though this is a self-selected reassurance rather than a guarantee for all sensitive users.
segments.normal: A reviewer with fairly normal skin reports the cleanser supports her Tula routine in managing hormonal breakouts since menopause, with no irritation noted.

concerns.aging: One reviewer, 66, with combination skin says the product balances her skin well; no other age-related effects (fine lines, firmness) are described.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report the cleanser leaves skin hydrated, soft and not stripped or tacky even without following up with other products; one reviewer with combination skin is the exception, describing skin feeling tighter and more drying than the original.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer notes the product does not create a film that blocks absorption of subsequent skincare steps; another notes it does not clog pores.
concerns.spots: Long-term Tula users report their dark spots have faded and complexion looks more even over time, but they attribute this to the fuller Tula regimen (moisturizers, sunscreen, primers) rather than this cleanser alone.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports her hormonal breakouts (post-menopause) have cleared using her Tula regimen; no other reviewer discusses acne or breakouts from this specific cleanser.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily T-zones or oily lower face report the cleanser controls oil and cleanses thoroughly without stripping, and one specifically notes it doesn't add to oiliness while still moisturizing drier areas.

aspects.libelle: Feels luxurious and elevated versus original

extraits.titre: As if the Cult Classic could get any better?
extraits.texte: I have used the Cult Classic for many years. It's the only facial wash I use that can take off every ounce of makeup and not dry my skin out. The new Cult Classic Luminous has somehow made my perfect skin wash even better. Between the scent and the moisture my skin has after, it couldn't be a better product. I find the product works best if you lather the gel in your hands with a bit of water and then work onto the skin, I love the smell, the feel and the glow I have afterwards. My skin is very prone to dryness (but also oily) with a lot of products on the market right now, so once I find something I like, I stick with it. This will be one of those products.

I have been using Tula products for a couple of years now, and I have to say I've seen a huge improvement in the over all condition of my skin. It has a much healthier appearance and more even tone. What I specifically appreciate about the new Luminous cleanser is how nicely it lathers, how good it smells, and how it leaves my face feeling after cleansing. I have combination skin, and it leaves my face hydrated and soft, but it also thoroughly cleanses my oily t-zone. It's a balanced clean, and although I received this bottle from Tula for an honest review, I will most definitely purchase in the future.

If I could, I would give this product 4.5 Stars. I've been using the original version of this cleanser (The Cult Classic) for years and have always loved it so I was excited to try the new formula. The first thing I noticed was the scent - it smells amazing and makes my skincare routine feel more luxurious. It does leave my skin feeling tighter than the original so it is a bit more drying for my combination skin. However, I do notice my complexion appears to be brighter and more radiant so that is a definite plus!

I wanted to give an honest review so I used the Luminous cleanser for a couple weeks to make sure. I absolutely love it!! From day 1 my skin literally felt brighter and cleaner. I have dry skin, especially around my nose and mouth and this totally improved the dryness. My skin LOOKS brighter! I don't know how else to describe it. I've been using the cult classic cleanser for years, but admit I don't love the scent of it. I LOVE the scent of the Luminous!! This might be my new favorite!!

extraits.titre: The Cult Classic, But Make It Luxurious
extraits.texte: The Cult Classic Luminous is a must have! I've used The Cult Classic for a couple of years and didn't think that it could get any better, but leave it to Tula to step it up a notch! The texture of this is fantastic - it's creamy, luxurious, and smells amazing. I have combination skin with a dry T zone but oily lower face and this product works great. It doesn't contribute to oiliness but adds moisture where needed. I will 100% be using this from here on out!

I love the Cult Classic Luminous cleanser. The scent is not overpowering-in fact, it adds a little oomph to my morning routine with a lovely fragrance. I get the same clean feeling the original offers. I have fairly normal skin. Since menopause, I experienced hormonal breakouts, but my Tula regimen has cleared my skin making me feel more confident. It feels wonderful. I highly recommend!

I was just about to purchase the Rich Rinse Cleanser to try when I was given the opportunity to use and review The Cult Classic Luminous cleanser. It is amazing! The smell is wonderful. The consistency of the cleanser is typical Tula. It has brightened my face just by using it for this short period. I have been a faithful Tula user for years. I started with The Cult Classic purifying face cleanser - both classic and fragrance free kinds. I know use the 24-7 moisturizers, Beauty Sleep, sunscreens and the Filter primers. The products have faded my dark spots and give a glow to my skin. This new product will definitely be in my rotation. The smell is the best part especially at night before bed. It's very calming and relaxing.
